limits: Nominal calibrated sensors and averaged actuator model. Repeats vary launch timing, not measured noise, mass, bias or friction. Extra initial states were used in earlier design iterations; they are not a fresh statistical holdout. No position/speed hold, real motor calibration, hardware validation or global optimum is established.
